// Generated by TIDE from 10 indicator(s), looking back 30 days. Check the dataset and field names before running.

// IPv4 addresses (1)
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where RemoteIP in ("203.0.113.45") or LocalIP in ("203.0.113.45")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, LocalIP, RemoteIP, RemotePort

// IPv6 addresses (1)
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where RemoteIP in ("2001:db8::7") or LocalIP in ("2001:db8::7")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, LocalIP, RemoteIP, RemotePort

// Domains (1)
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("update-check.example.net")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP

// URLs (1)
UrlClickEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where Url in~ ("https://login.example.com/owa?x=1")
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url, ActionType

// MD5 hashes (1)
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where MD5 in~ ("44d88612fea8a8f36de82e1278abb02f")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, MD5

// SHA-256 hashes (1)
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where SHA256 in~ ("275a021bbfb6489e54d471899f7db9d1663fc695ec2fe2a2c4538aabf651fd0f")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256

// File names (1)
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName in~ ("invoice_viewer.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256

// Email addresses (1)
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where SenderFromAddress in~ ("billing@example.org") or RecipientEmailAddress in~ ("billing@example.org")
| project Timestamp, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction

// Hosts (1)
DeviceInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where DeviceName in~ ("WS-0142")
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by DeviceName
